categories.main_business_segments: NICE Information Service Co., Ltd. operates primarily in personal credit information services, corporate information services, asset management (including debt collection and credit investigation), big data services, and consulting. The company also engages in new business areas such as loan brokerage, MyData services, IP collateral evaluation, and cloud computing services. Its subsidiaries support these segments, including debt collection and big data analytics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages extensive credit databases and proprietary credit scoring systems (CSS) for personal and corporate credit evaluation. It utilizes big data analytics and AI/ML technologies for data processing, visualization, and market analysis. Development of integrated platforms like NICE Jikimi and API-based MyData services underpin its technology infrastructure. The company also conducts technology credit evaluations and ESG assessments using specialized methodologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include financial institutions such as banks, credit card companies, insurance firms, and non-financial sectors like telecommunications, retail, and public institutions. The company serves both individual consumers and corporate clients, providing credit information, risk management, and consulting services. Its big data services target public agencies, franchises, and manufacturing sectors. The loan brokerage and MyData services cater to consumers seeking financial products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in South Korea, with subsidiaries extending operations to Vietnam. Its services cover domestic financial markets and corporate sectors, with some export sales. The company’s headquarters and main facilities are located in Seoul, South Korea, and it has established data centers and offices domestically and in Vietnam.
categories.supply_chain_position: NICE Information Service Co., Ltd. operates mainly as a midstream data aggregator and service provider within the credit information and financial services supply chain. It collects, processes, and analyzes credit and corporate data, providing value-added information and consulting to downstream financial institutions and businesses. It also acts as a platform intermediary in new digital finance services like MyData and loan brokerage.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on expanding digital financial services including MyData and loan brokerage, enhancing AI and big data analytics capabilities, and developing integrated credit evaluation platforms. It invests in R&D for credit scoring methodologies, platform UI/UX improvements, and automation of corporate information services. Strategic priorities include market expansion in emerging data-driven finance sectors, technology credit evaluation, and ESG-related services.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through subscription and usage fees for credit information services, consulting fees for credit risk management and corporate evaluations, commissions from debt collection activities, and service fees from big data analytics. The company also earns revenue from licensing its credit scoring systems and providing platform-based financial product brokerage. Pricing models include fixed monthly fees, per-use charges, and performance-based commissions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with Korea Credit Bureau (KCB) and other emerging credit information providers in South Korea. It holds a leading position in the domestic credit information market with the largest credit database and strong consulting capabilities. In loan brokerage and MyData services, it faces competition from fintech and big tech platforms like Toss and KakaoPay. Its asset management and big data segments compete with specialized service providers but maintain strong market recognition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of the 40th fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 485.7 billion KRW with steady growth across its business segments. Total assets increased by 2.62% year-over-year to about 493.7 billion KRW, and equity grew by 8.18% to 369.6 billion KRW. Operating profit was 65.3 billion KRW, with a slight decrease compared to the prior year, while net income increased by 6.36%. The company maintains a strong capital structure with a low debt ratio around 34%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: NICE Information Service Co., Ltd. differentiates itself through its extensive and high-quality credit information databases, advanced credit scoring and risk management solutions, and integrated digital platforms like NICE Jikimi. Its long-standing industry experience and regulatory licenses provide credibility and trust. The company emphasizes tailored consulting services, innovative MyData offerings combining diverse data sources, and comprehensive corporate and technology credit evaluations to deliver superior customer insights and financial decision support.
